pageErrorFailure.sourceDiagnosis: Automatic navigation prefetch observed; final6 disables default automatic link prefetch and requires fresh compiled regression evidence. Exact browser internals are not inferred from the message.

failure.message: Failed to read the 'localStorage' property from 'Window': Access is denied for this document.
failure.cause: Private-prefetch fixture init script accessed localStorage in an opaque-origin initial document.
failure.fix: Guard fixture initialization against opaque/non-HTTP origin; retain every live pageerror assertion. No application source changed.

completedRuns.note: This failed harness run proves neither an application defect nor a completed browser matrix. The accepted repeat must have separate current-build evidence; source fingerprint alone does not turn this failure into a PASS.

failure.message: Target page, context or browser has been closed
failure.phase: public calculator tail / final viewport restoration
failure.cause: Browser process closed; root cause not proven. Cgroup8GB memory peak/counter without a before-run baseline does not establish OOM causality.
failure.nextAction: Repeat all Firefox scopes on a fresh isolated fixture using bounded browser recycling between full viewport groups and before calculator tail. Preserve live fatal-error assertions and browser default BFCache.

completedRuns.note: Only completed Chromium/WebKit engine evidence can contribute to a later compatible two-run composition. Stopped Firefox controls/scenarios are retained as raw history and must not be promoted as passed or pooled with a new Firefox run.

accessibility.scope: Isolated synthetic account; rendered pages, WCAG A/AA automated checks; does not certify human/screen-reader accessibility
accessibility.manualKnownExpenseFilterDefect: Fixed in app final4 and reverified by the full final6 matrix in 24 actual filter states across three engines and two themes.
accessibility.manualReviewLimit: Remaining incomplete axe groups are not automatically passed. The historical avatar pixel measurement proves one earlier-build gradient; targeted final6 filter styles prove this filter only. No complete human or screen-reader certification.

browserMatrix.executionNote: Three engines completed in two explicitly compatible runs; this is not a single all-engine successful process. Only completed engine proofs are composed.

composition.method: Only complete passed engines from two independent isolated runs of the exact same application source and compiled build; no partial failed Firefox proof is promoted.
composition.executionNote: Chromium and WebKit completed in the first run; Firefox completed in a fresh isolated database run with browser process recycling between viewports and before interactions. This is not a claim that one full three-engine invocation exited successfully.
composition.harnessChanges: Validated optional engine filter; Firefox process/context recycling preserves cookies/localStorage/auth, touch/viewport/service-worker settings and collected observations; browser history preferences unchanged. Every live document pageerror remains fatal. Calculator cleanup preserves the original failure.
composition.priorFailureCauseLimit: The previous Firefox process closed during tail interactions. An 8 GiB container limit and cumulative OOM counters were observed, but no counter baseline for that invocation exists; the exact cause is not asserted.
